setupCorrections: After synchronous programmatic GUI stress, native canvas recapture is performed after native pause restoration before issuing chat commands, matching the established actual-client test protocol. Physical pointer-lock feel remains pending.

The food fixture left hunger below the Sprint threshold, so a later held-forward movement check walked off the platform. Native saturation/health effects now isolate the movement fixture; acceptance resumes from the existing supported checkpoint and keeps passed-prefix evidence separate.

Saved-world food setup initially stopped at hunger 16, outside the module threshold. The test now applies bounded repeated native hunger effects and verifies the precondition; no player snapshot is fabricated.
Earlier probe fixture fell before the origin platform was loaded; repeat waits for chunks and verifies platform position. Invalid probes are not accepted evidence.
Initial disable assertion sampled before an already-committed native hit published health. Final checks separate immediate queue clearing from settled damage and verify no new attempts.
A test-only unqualified reference to the intentionally deleted command queue was corrected to window.__eaghacksNativeCommands; no client change was required.

Repeated-toggle native testing found a hidden ClickGUI search field retaining focus; fixed close() focus release and added a failing-before/passing-after regression. Final artifact was refreshed and rechecked.
Intermediate candidate run was stopped after review found secondary-module queue cancellation; final candidate rechecked after the fix.
remainingBlockers: Exhaustive per-setting and per-module world transition/interaction coverage
Actual other-player ESP and combat filters
Seven deferred LAN checks; existing intermittent lobby limitation remains
